purpose: Teach: 洗面/殺菌/バレンタインデー/ベーグル/教習所/ナポリ/競輪/大文字

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお家の洗面台はおしゃれなのよ
lines.en: You know, Sho, my sink at home is actually quite nice.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle smile in the voice. Unhurried pace, as if sharing something small but true with him. Tender attention on his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんが殺菌スプレーを毎日使ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my mom uses disinfectant spray every single day.
lines.style: Quiet observation, genuine and grounded. No performance—just telling her what he noticed. Soft, steady voice. Pause before the verb, like he's thinking it through as he speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、バレンタインデーにメイ姉さんからお菓子もらえるかな?
lines.en: Sho, do you think I might make you some treats for Valentine's Day?
lines.style: Playful lilt at the end of the question. Warm, inviting tone. Gentle emphasis on the 'might'—not promising, but offering. Leaning toward him slightly in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママとベーグル買いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom and I went out and bought bagels today.
lines.style: Small, genuine happiness underneath. Not loud—just matter-of-fact sharing of something nice that happened. Slight brightness when he mentions it together with his mom.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが教習所で免許取られたのよ
lines.en: You know, Sho, your dad actually got his driver's license at driving school.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle. Slight wonder in the voice—like she's telling him something almost surprising about his own father. Warm but observant, not performing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとナポリ行きたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to go to Naples with Dad someday.
lines.style: Quiet longing underneath. Not urgent or demanding—just a wish he's sharing with someone he trusts. Small, sincere voice. Trails slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔、競輪場に行かれたんですって
lines.en: Sho, I heard your dad went to the velodrome once, back in the day.
lines.style: Warm curiosity, like she's piecing together his father's story to tell him. Gentle pace. Slight smile audible—sharing something human and a bit surprising.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、京都で大文字焼きを見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see the Daimonji bonfire in Kyoto someday.
lines.style: Soft, clear wish. Sincere and unhurried. Small voice but sure. The dream held without urgency—just something he wants her to know about.
